text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Damn... I'm not even on the scoreboard...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey! You recorded the race, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Send me the data straight away so I can
identify
what went wrong and rewrite
the algorithm for
next time.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You think I need you to tell me
that?
choice_data_list: 諦めない姿勢は素晴らしい

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I just need to raise the accuracy of my
program,
and the next race should go as
calculated.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No way I'm gonna leave the code I've
been
workin' on for so long unfinished.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Of course, first place is as good as mine.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll use every means at my disposal to get
it. That
includes you, obviously.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna let anyone look down on
me
again...
